# GROWNIS

> Full-funnel marketing agency — Senior expertise, AI speed. Founded by Maria Bratchikova and Alyona Kozlova. 15+ years of experience, AI tooling, and a network of trusted partners. Based in Barcelona, working with projects worldwide.

GROWNIS owns a client's growth funnel under a single point of accountability, acting as a fractional Head of Growth. Senior experts set direction, AI agents handle the volume, and experts validate the result — the Senior × AI model. No juniors on client projects. The agency covers the full funnel: from research and positioning to acquisition, content, data, and retention, plus marketplaces.

## Pages
- [Home — EN](https://grownis.com/): English landing — cases, solutions, focused expertise, principles, engagement models, team, contact.
- [Home — RU](https://grownis.com/ru/): Russian version of the landing.
- [Tech events](https://grownis.com/tech-ai-events/): Marketing for launching AI/tech events — conferences, hackathons, competitions, demo days, summits.
- [Growth Score](https://grownis.com/score/): Free 3-minute growth diagnostic — 12 questions across 6 areas, a 0–36 score, a tier (Chaotic / Reactive / Systematic / Compounding), and fix playbooks.
- [Growth Score — RU](https://grownis.com/ru/score/): Russian version of the growth diagnostic.

## Services
- Research & Insight — audience, JTBD interviews, market and competitive analysis, product-line review.
- Strategy & Positioning — growth strategy, brand platform, go-to-market.
- Acquisition & Retention — media and performance, SEM; customer lifecycle, loyalty, promo, trigger communication.
- Content, Social & PR — content system, social, PR, creators and ambassadors.
- Integration & Setup — CRM, CDP and personalization platforms; onboarding and coordinating contractors.
- Marketplaces — seller-account analytics, growth strategy, ad campaigns on Amazon / Ozon / WB.

## Focused expertise
- Data & Growth partner for agencies
- Marketplace growth
- Tech products with niche audiences (AI, SaaS, developer platforms)
- CRM architecture & communication automation
